notes: **A keyguard on posts with nothing exposed along the top of the screen now goes into its keyguard frame either way round.** Its post sits on the keyguard's own top edge, so the frame has a notch for the post along the top of the keyguard's opening, about half the keyguard's thickness deep. The frame now has the same notch along the bottom, and the keyguard is that much longer at the bottom to fill it, so it fits turned 180 degrees and its latch still reaches the frame either way. The opening in the frame ends up a few millimetres taller than the height you entered. Keyguards that expose a bar along the top of the screen already went in either way round and are unchanged. If you made a keyguard and frame like this, open the design again and export both once you have this version.

**A keyguard on posts that exposes a bar along the bottom of the screen now has latches on its left and right edges**, with matching grooves in the sides of the keyguard frame, in place of the latch on its bottom edge, and it now ends along the top of the bottom bar, just as it ends along the bottom of a bar exposed at the top. The bottom bar's opening could take away all the plastic under that latch, leaving it as a loose sliver attached to nothing, and the keyguard's sides were left hanging below the bar as two thin prongs. The side latches sit halfway up the sides, so they line up whichever way round the keyguard goes. If you made a keyguard and frame like this, open the design again and export both once you have this version.

**You can now swing a keyguard on posts up out of its keyguard frame to see how it goes in and out.** With the keyguard shown in its frame, the new setting Rotate keyguard on posts, under Keyguard Frame Info, turns it up on its posts from 0 to 120 degrees, 15 degrees at a time. If the keyguard would run into the frame at the angle you choose, the Console says so and tells you roughly how far it can swing before it does. A keyguard whose post sits on its own top edge usually clears the frame to just past upright. The latches are left out of this check, because they are meant to click past the frame.
